sonnet.problem: The fill-in-the-blank asks the baker to supply a word from the verse. Card 1 cuts the quote off at 'Jerusalem…', so 'prophets' is wording the baker hasn't seen. Nothing on the cards lets them reason it out, so it comes down to luck.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
